final: WITH pattern_avgs AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_igg FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS value FROM pattern_avgs), above_avg AS (SELECT p.pattern, p.avg_igg, p.avg_igg - o.value AS difference FROM pattern_avgs AS p CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS o WHERE o.value IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_igg > o.value), selected_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS value FROM above_avg) SELECT a.pattern, a.avg_igg, a.difference, a.avg_igg - s.value FROM above_avg AS a CROSS JOIN selected_avg AS s WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL
